verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents a REST API (with public/secret keys) and an MCP server explicitly claiming AI assistants can 'manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard,' plus API endpoints for refunds and promotional grants that are otherwise dashboard actions. However, no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404s) and dashboard-only features like charts/analytics and the Rico chat assistant aren't shown to have full API parity. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of full API/UI parity, public OpenAPI spec, and API equivalents for analytics/reporting and Rico-style insights.
